# Talent Guides

<!-- This page is generated by tools/talents/build.py. -->

A talent guide for each of the **9 classes**. Each guide shows all 3 trees, gives a rating to each talent, and tells you where to put each point from level 10 to 60.

??? info "How the talent guides work · current as of 10 November 2026"
    - **Tree data:** from the game client, build 1.60.1.70862, as read by [wowforevertalents.com](https://wowforevertalents.com/).
    - **Ratings:** Codex ratings from S (core) to D (do not take), for leveling, PvE and PvP. No source has published simulations.
    - **Builds:** a script checks each build against the rules of the tree. Each build has a link to a talent calculator.
    - The class guides give rotations, routes and gear. Find them in [Class & Race Guides](../guides/index.md).

## Pick a class

<div class="grid cards fc-multi fc-class-card" markdown>

-   :codex-druid:{ .lg .middle } **[Druid](druid.md)**

    ---

    **Tank · Healer · DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Feral: Bear to level 19, Cat from level 20
    - **PvE at 60:** Bear tank, Cat or Moonkin damage, Restoration healer
    - **PvP:** Restoration with Feral Charge and Furor

-   :codex-hunter:{ .lg .middle } **[Hunter](hunter.md)**

    ---

    **DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Beast Mastery. The pet tanks while you shoot
    - **PvE at 60:** Marksmanship with Lone Wolf. Beast Mastery if you keep the pet
    - **PvP:** Survival for traps and roots, or Marksmanship with Scatter Shot

-   :codex-mage:{ .lg .middle } **[Mage](mage.md)**

    ---

    **DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Frost (safe) or Arcane (fast solo)
    - **PvE at 60:** Fire or Arcane. Frost for fights with much Fire damage
    - **PvP:** Frost with Improved Counterspell

-   :codex-paladin:{ .lg .middle } **[Paladin](paladin.md)**

    ---

    **Tank · Healer · DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Retribution. Protection if you level in dungeons
    - **PvE at 60:** Holy to heal, Protection to tank, Retribution for damage
    - **PvP:** Retribution with Repentance and Improved Hammer of Justice

-   :codex-priest:{ .lg .middle } **[Priest](priest.md)**

    ---

    **Healer · DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Shadow Magic (fast) or Discipline (safe)
    - **PvE at 60:** Holy or Discipline to heal. Shadow Magic for damage
    - **PvP:** Shadow Magic with Silence, or Discipline to heal

-   :codex-rogue:{ .lg .middle } **[Rogue](rogue.md)**

    ---

    **DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Combat with a slow main-hand weapon
    - **PvE at 60:** Combat or Assassination (Mutilate). Subtlety is not tested
    - **PvP:** Subtlety with Preparation and Death Mark

-   :codex-shaman:{ .lg .middle } **[Shaman](shaman.md)**

    ---

    **Healer · DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Enhancement (fast and safe) or Elemental (ranged)
    - **PvE at 60:** Restoration to heal. Elemental or Enhancement for damage
    - **PvP:** Elemental with Nature's Swiftness, or Enhancement

-   :codex-warlock:{ .lg .middle } **[Warlock](warlock.md)**

    ---

    **DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Affliction (fast solo) or Demonology (safe)
    - **PvE at 60:** Affliction, Demonology or Destruction. Destruction for dungeons
    - **PvP:** Demonology with Soul Link and Curse of Exhaustion

-   :codex-warrior:{ .lg .middle } **[Warrior](warrior.md)**

    ---

    **Tank · DPS**

    - **Leveling:** Protection (solo) or Arms (groups)
    - **PvE at 60:** Protection to tank. Fury or Arms for damage
    - **PvP:** Arms with Mortal Strike

</div>
